name: What are the most impactful accessibility features to consider for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the most impactful accessibility features to consider for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning an accessibility remodel, highly impactful features include creating wider doorways and pathways for easy navigation, installing lower or adjustable-height countertops and sinks, and integrating pull-out shelves or drawers for effortless storage access. Consider touchless faucets, smart appliance controls, and proper task lighting to enhance usability. AKN Design Group guides homeowners through these options, helping to prioritize features that directly address their needs and lifestyle, ensuring the final design is both practical and aesthetically pleasing.
